title: Mewan
extract:
The Mewan is a  Slash-focused large bladed Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Mewan blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike primarily deals  Slash damage.

25%  Impact
35%  Puncture
40%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Sword
Polearm

Trivia
Mewan's shape appears to be based on an old-fashioned bone saw.
